name: gh-dash-stable-row-identity-and-navigation-1376
instr:
Give gh-dash stable identities for selectable rows and browser-like back and forward navigation across views, sections, enrichment, and refreshes. Navigation should follow logical GitHub objects rather than display data or stale row instances. Existing notification presentation, controls, and actions must remain unchanged when the feature is unused.

Every IssueData, PullRequestData, NotificationData, prrow.Data, notificationrow.Data, and BranchData returned through section.Table.GetCurrRow has a deterministic RowIdentity whose RowIdentity.Equal, IdentityKind, and StableKey reflect logical object identity, with repository and kind preventing collisions and NavigationTarget expressing navigation-only aliases. Issue and pull-request identities survive mutable GraphQL data, PR wrappers retain primary identity through enrichment, notifications alias safely derivable issues or pull requests and otherwise retain notification identity, and branches remain distinct and safe without remotes. History records successful user selections in insertion order, suppresses only adjacent equivalents, truncates abandoned forward history, evicts oldest entries at capacity, and preserves a valid cursor. Back and Forward skip unavailable entries without reordering and return HistoryTarget, HistoryBoundary, or HistoryUnavailable through HistoryResult while failures and empty history preserve the visible selection without panicking. Model records user selection changes but not restoration or unrelate
